environment.description: EKS pod running in private subnet with IAM role 'stream-processor-role' attached via IRSA. The IAM role has s3:PutObject permission with Resource 'arn:aws:s3:::*' (overly broad). Kafka topic 'ingest-events' has ACLs allowing any authenticated producer. VPC has a default S3 gateway endpoint (com.amazonaws.us-east-1.s3) with no endpoint policy restrictions (full access policy). The pod's service account is annotated with the broad IAM role.

config.network: private subnet, all S3 traffic routes through VPC endpoint
